summary.text: Jacob Helberg has said that winning the AI race requires both the best innovation and the most diffusion, and that the central question is who controls the industrial foundations that make AI possible. In official testimony as Under Secretary of State for Economic Affairs, he described Pax Silica as a coalition focused on rebuilding supply security across infrastructure, industrial capacity, and critical technologies, and as an economic security architecture to reduce strategic dependency and build reliable redundancy. He has described AI-era supply chains as leverage and dependency as vulnerability, and said AI is reshaping the global economy. He has also advocated a pro-innovation, pro-growth approach to AI and argued that AI will create jobs and growth rather than suppress workers.
